LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_SoulRemnantState.description: Surplus nutrition gradually rebuilds Neiyu's body. Up to 5 nutrition can be stored per day. As she stores nutrition, her base stats rise. This progress resets when she dies.
Allows Neiyu to eat extra food beyond her usual meals, automatically storing up to 2 nutrition per day. The daily total cannot exceed 5.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_SoulRecovery.description: Neiyu is rebuilding her body. For 12 hours she is invulnerable, cannot move and cannot be controlled.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_SoulRemnantState.label: Soul Remnant Incarnate
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_SoulRecovery.label: Dormant Soul
